Resource Name: Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) clinical and T1-weighted MRI data (controlled access under the PPMI Data Use Agreement)

De-identified derived data (group-level summary statistics for whole amygdala, subregion and nucleus volumes; mixed-effects, survival and subtype results; source data for Figures 1 to 3); includes data dictionary
Analysis scripts (quality control and covariate adjustment; cross-sectional, longitudinal mixed-effects and survival analyses; figure generation); includes README
FreeSurfer v7.3.2 (recon-all and hippocampal and amygdala nuclei segmentation)
Source: Athinoula A. Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging
